enunciado: Implement DoublyLinkedList with head and tail references, nodes with previous and next, pushBack, remove(v) and forward and backward traversals. Remove a middle node, the head and the tail, showing both traversals.
objetivos: Remove in O(1) once the node is known
pistas: Each node points to its previous and its next.
When removing adjust two links: previous.next and next.previous.
If the node is the head or the tail, update those references too.
